boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Ithaca College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Ithaca destinations with currently documented access at 10 p.m. or later, spanning South Hill, downtown, Collegetown, and practical cross-town stops.

cards.title: Louie's Lunch After Dark
cards.subtitle: A Cornell-campus food truck serving until 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Check the posted schedule, then head to the front of Risley Hall for a late order; the trip from South Hill requires a planned ride.
cards.short_summary: A long-running campus food truck with the latest verified closing time on this board.
cards.evidence_claim: Louie's official site identifies its location at the front of Risley Hall and lists Monday–Saturday hours of 5 p.m.–3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are Monday–Saturday, 5 p.m.–3 a.m.; no Sunday hours are listed. This is an outdoor food-truck stop.

cards.title: Calzones Past Midnight
cards.subtitle: A Collegetown counter with ordering through 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Confirm pickup availability before crossing town, since the ordering page separates the midnight-to-3 a.m. period from evening hours.
cards.short_summary: A late-order calzone stop in Collegetown with a clearly posted overnight window.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ithaca To Go ordering page identifies D.P. Dough at 408 College Avenue and lists ordering from 4 p.m.–3 a.m. daily, split at midnight.
cards.source_title: DP Dough Delivery Menu - Ithaca | Order Online
cards.access_notes: Current ordering hours are 4 p.m.–midnight and midnight–3 a.m. every day; verify whether the desired service mode is pickup or delivery.

cards.title: The South Meadow Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Late service on the commercial corridor west of South Hill
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the dining room closes, and arrange a car or ride before leaving campus; pedestrian access is not the late-night option.
cards.short_summary: A practical south-side food run whose drive-through operates three hours beyond the dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists the 222 Elmira Road drive-through as open until 1 a.m. every day and the dining room until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Ithaca, NY - 222 Elmira Road
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are 8 a.m.–1 a.m. daily; dine-in closes at 10 p.m. Late access therefore requires a vehicle.

cards.title: The North-Ithaca Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A second 1 a.m. option near Triphammer Marketplace
cards.notes: Choose this branch only when your route already leads north; after 10 p.m., plan on drive-through service and confirm transportation first.
cards.short_summary: The northern counterpart to the Elmira Road branch, useful when the night ends near Lansing or northeast Ithaca.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page identifies the 2301 North Triphammer Road restaurant and lists drive-through service until 1 a.m. seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Ithaca, NY - 2301 N. Triphammer Rd.
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are 7 a.m.–1 a.m. daily; the listed dine-in closing time is 10 p.m., so late access requires a vehicle.

cards.title: Cookies Until 1 a.m.
cards.subtitle: A dessert counter at 319 College Avenue
cards.notes: Check the store page before departing, then pair this stop with another Collegetown errand to avoid making a separate cross-town trip.
cards.short_summary: A focused dessert run with a consistent overnight closing time near Cornell's Collegetown.
cards.evidence_claim: The linked store listing identifies Insomnia Cookies at 319 College Avenue and reports service until 1 a.m. throughout the week.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies in Ithaca, NY United States
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Monday–Friday and noon–1 a.m. Saturday–Sunday; verify holiday variations before traveling.

cards.title: The Midnight Grocery Run
cards.subtitle: Groceries and prepared-food departments on South Meadow Street
cards.notes: Make a list before leaving campus and arrive well ahead of midnight, since individual prepared-food departments may close before the main store.
cards.short_summary: A late practical run for groceries, snacks, and household supplies rather than a restaurant-only stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Wegmans' official Ithaca store page lists the supermarket at 500 South Meadow Street as open from 6 a.m. to midnight seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The main store is officially open 6 a.m.–midnight daily; pharmacy and individual department hours are shorter.

cards.title: An All-Ages Café at Midnight
cards.subtitle: Espresso, tea, and alcohol-free elixirs on South Geneva Street
cards.notes: Go Thursday through Saturday for the midnight window, and review the event schedule if you want music or art with the café visit.
cards.short_summary: A deliberately evening-oriented café whose official site explicitly describes it as an all-ages venue.
cards.evidence_claim: The café's official site lists Thursday–Saturday hours of 4 p.m.–midnight and features an endorsement describing the venue as all-ages.
cards.source_title: The Nocturnal Café | Espresso and Tea Bar
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Wednesday until 10 p.m. and Thursday–Saturday until midnight; closed Sunday. The site describes the venue as all-ages.

cards.title: A Weekend Dinner Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: A downtown restaurant serving late on Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Reserve this for Friday or Saturday, confirm kitchen service before leaving South Hill, and request the dining room rather than bar seating.
cards.short_summary: A full downtown dinner option with a documented weekend midnight close and a kids menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Revelry Yards' official site lists dinner until midnight Friday and Saturday, identifies its downtown address, and notes a kids menu.
cards.source_title: Revelry Yards — American Restaurant, Brewery & Beer Garden in Ithaca, NY
cards.access_notes: Dinner is listed until midnight Friday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; confirm the kitchen's last seating before travel.

cards.title: A 10 p.m. Kitchen on Aurora Street
cards.subtitle: Southwestern dinner with zero-proof choices downtown
cards.notes: Arrive before 10 p.m. even on midnight-closing nights, because the official page says the kitchen closes at 10 p.m. every day it operates.
cards.short_summary: An earlier late-night option where the venue stays open after its clearly documented kitchen cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: Sedona Mesa Grill's official site lists Friday–Saturday venue hours until midnight, a daily 10 p.m. kitchen close, zero-proof drinks, and a children's menu.
cards.source_title: Sedona Mesa Grill Restaurant in Ithaca, NY
cards.access_notes: The kitchen closes at 10 p.m. daily. Venue hours extend to midnight Friday–Saturday; the restaurant is closed Tuesday.

cards.title: Stay on South Hill Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: A campus alternative to a cross-town run
cards.notes: Use the published Friday or Saturday midnight window for Campus Center activities, and check dining separately because food outlets keep different hours.
cards.short_summary: The only on-campus late stop here, offering a safer alternative when a trip downtown is unnecessary.
cards.evidence_claim: Ithaca College's Campus Center services page lists Friday hours from noon–midnight and Saturday hours from 5 p.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Campus Center service hours run until midnight Friday and Saturday and until 10:30 p.m. Monday–Thursday; dining hours must be checked separately.

warnings: Late hours can change during academic breaks, holidays, and summer; verify the linked source immediately before departure.

D.P. Dough hours are supported by the restaurant's active local ordering partner, and Insomnia Cookies hours by its linked map listing, because directly accessible official location pages did not expose current Ithaca hours.
All ten cards have direct late-hours evidence current within the template's 120-day freshness window; coordinates and maps URLs remain null because they were not independently verified.
